description: Shared API versioning, sync record envelope, and proxy request/response contracts for the optional Kazo OS server. Referenced by both the ASP.NET Core server and the browser client adapter.
releaseNotes:
Kazo OS 3.4.3, changes for app developers:
- A network app knows whether the Kazo server's relay works. KazoRealNetwork.GetRelayStateAsync tells an app holding network.real.access, without trying, whether the Kazo server's relay can carry its connections (no server, relay turned off, permission not received yet, ready with the blocked ports), and RelayStateChanged says when it changes. A failed connection now says why: KazoTcpClient and KazoUdpClient throw a KazoRelayException with the same SocketError as before, KazoHttp carries ERR_KAZO_RELAY_* codes, and curl, wget, cat and the Browser explain them (ADR 0278).
- An app with only filesystem.private.* can create its ~/.config folder. KazoDirectory.CreateDirectoryAsync no longer fails with CapabilityDenied on ~/.config when the app may create its own ~/.config/<appId>/ but not look at ~/.config.
- On mobile, the top of an app answers touches again. The notification shade's handle now has a status-bar strip of its own above the open app, instead of covering the app's top buttons.
- A trimmed publish writes the API surface it ships. A trimmed publish of a host now writes kazoos-api-surface.json.gz next to wwwroot/: every assembly it ships with its types, methods and fields, so an app can be checked against the trimmed OS before it is published (ADR 0277).
- An app's build refuses APIs the trimmed OS removed. KazoOsPack now checks the package against the API surface of the targeted Kazo OS, which Kazo.Os.App.Build brings: a call to a member the trimmed OS does not have fails the build with KOSAPP0100 and a replacement when one is known, instead of being refused at installation. KazoOsApiCheck=false turns it into the warning KOSAPP0101 (ADR 0277).
Release notes: https://github.com/Kazo-ca/Os/releases/tag/v3.4.3
